specialRules.ruleFull: Any member of the warband within 6" of the Arch Mage may use his Leadership for a Leadership test.
The Arch Mage may take spells from two of the elemental lores, and starts with two spells, one from each.
The Mage casts from one elemental lore and starts with one spell from it.
The Warlock casts from the Lesser Magic list and starts with two spells.

An Apprentice may cast Cantrip: difficulty 10, range 12". The target may take a Leadership test, and the Cantrip has no effect if he passes it. If the casting succeeds, roll:

Roll | Result
1-5 | The target is frozen in place and may not charge, attack or move, but defends as normal.
6 | The target is stunned.
An Apprentice who becomes a Hero chooses one elemental lore to learn spells from, or takes spells from the Lesser Magic list instead.
A Clockwork Construct has a 5+ armour save, gains no experience and may carry no weapons, but suffers no penalty for being unarmed.
A Clockwork Construct is not affected by psychology.
A Clockwork Construct may not run.

specialSkillsList.name: Dispel
specialSkillsList.description: The Hero may try to dispel a spell that has just been cast by rolling higher than the casting roll that succeeded. A sorcerer who cast on a 10 is dispelled only on an 11 or 12.

specialSkillsList.name: Store Spell
specialSkillsList.description: The Hero must carry a staff. He chooses a spell and casts it into the staff, which holds it for that game if the casting succeeds. He may cast it from the staff later with +3 to the casting roll; if he rolls a double when he does, the stored spell is lost.

specialSkillsList.name: Clockwork Mage
specialSkillsList.description: The Hero may pay 5 gold crowns for each Clockwork Construct in a group to raise its Movement or its Weapon Skill by 1. A characteristic may be raised twice at most, only one characteristic may be raised per game, and the whole group must be raised at once.

flags.what: The PDF prints no starting gold, only "Mage Warband -max 12". The template carries our 500 gc default.

The Arch Mage takes spells from "2 of the elemental spell lists" and the Mage from one. The Khemri setting's own Elemental Magic PDF (https://www.broheim.net/downloads/campaigns/khemri/Elemental%20Magic.pdf, 1-2, text layer; read 12 Nov 2026) holds four lists of six spells - Ice, Fire, Wind and Earth - and none of them is any of our four Elemental Lores (Air, Earth, Fire, Water), the Sorcerous Society's Mordheim 2a lores, which both casters pointed at until now. Both are now given Khemri's Ice Magic, Fire Magic, Wind Magic and Earth Magic. The "two of them" and "one of them" limits stay in each one's Wizard rule.

Elemental Magic p1-2: Numming Cold is spelt so on the page and kept as printed. Its "target model is at -1 to injury roll (If a 1 is rolled then the wound is useless)" does not say whose rolls, and is carried as written.

Elemental Magic p2: Stone Hands prints "the target is attacked by two hands. The hands have WS4, S4, A2", which does not say whether the 2 Attacks are each hand's or the pair's; carried as written. Earth Lore's difficulty is printed "auto" and is carried as Auto.

Elemental Magic p1: Fireball (difficulty 8, range 16", one S5 hit) is noted on the page as "the lesser magic version", but our Lesser Magic fireball is Fires of U'Zhul (difficulty 7, range 18", one S4 hit), so Khemri's Fireball is kept as its own spell with the page's numbers. Our Arabian Elemental Magic (Khemri 1b, the Arabian Tomb Raiders' Mystic, from mordheimer) is a six-spell list of its own that shares three names with these four (Riding the Wind, Burning Hand, Skin of Stone/Stone Skin) at different difficulties and holds two spells these lists do not (Quicksand, Storm of Magic): it is left untouched. See the decisions.
The Apprentices are "0-3 per mage hero (max 6)"; the simpler reading, 0-6, is imported (William: "just keep 0-1 dont complicate it").
"Clockwork Beasts - 0-5" in the choice of warriors is the entry headed "Clockwork Construct - 30"; the entry's name and count are taken.

Cantrip is printed under the Magician Skills column but is the Apprentices' spell ("Cantrips - see above"), so it is the Apprentice's rule with its difficulty, range and chart rather than a Hero's skill.
The Clockwork Construct's Leadership is printed as "-", and its profile has W2 and a 5+ save; as printed.
The Apprentice's profile prints S2; as printed.

The Familiar line prints no price, only "per TC#10". Our Familiar is 20+1D6 gc Rare 8 from Town Cryer 10, so the line carries 20 gc. Its "Arch Mage only when creating a warband, Heroes after that" cannot be read into a line note, so it is flagged here rather than imported.
The list's Dueling pistol is our Duelling Pistol (30 gc Rare 10 globally) at the list price of 25 gc, and its Staff is our Club, Mace or Hammer.
No group sizes are printed, and the warband has no special rules of its own.
